facts.fact: The National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda states that the national centralised civil registration system (NCI-CRVS) is fully operational at all five categories of registration office, among them cells, sectors and districts, for the registration of vital events in 2025.
facts.system: National Centralized and Integrated Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (NCI-CRVS) system

systems.system: National Centralized and Integrated Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (NCI-CRVS) system
systems.owner: National Identification Agency (NIDA) with NISR; coordination chaired by the Minister of Local Government
systems.tiers: health facilities, cells, sectors, districts and embassies
